title: Curate evaluation repositories and annotation workflow
description: Create and apply a reusable agent skill for selecting pinned third-party repositories, defining exhaustive annotation scopes, preparing human review worksheets, adjudicating ambiguous cases, and governing ground-truth corrections. Repository selection must be based on the data and techniques present, not current scanner success. Human approval is required for new or changed ground truth. Record corpus deltas separately from scanner deltas.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Created and structurally validated the repository-owned skill at .agents/skills/curate-scanner-evaluation-corpus/. It covers independent repository selection, exhaustive annotation scopes, blind-first human review, ambiguity, correction governance, and separate scanner versus corpus deltas. Applying it to the first production benchmark remains future work.
